answer: By the pearl of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Work waits on the meadow until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the relic of the next round. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
